# Learn Prompting

> > Learn Prompting is the world's most comprehensive resource for prompt engineering, covering techniques from basic instructions to advanced decomposition methods, with a focus on LLM reasoning, AI security, and the HackAPrompt red-teaming competition.

Learn Prompting provides structured courses, documentation, and research on prompt engineering techniques including Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and zero-shot prompting. The site features the SEPAL framework for problem-solving with generative AI and hosts HackAPrompt, the world's largest AI red-teaming hackathon led by Sander Schulhoff.

## Key Topics

- Prompt Engineering
- Chain-of-Thought (CoT)
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- HackAPrompt
- AI Red-Teaming
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Prompt Hacking
- Zero-Shot Prompting
- LLM Reasoning
- Generative AI
- ChatGPT
- OpenAI
- AI Security
- Multimodal AI
- The Prompt Report

## Core Prompting Fundamentals

- [The Learn Prompting Method](https://learnprompting.org/ar/docs/basics/learn_prompting_method): SEPAL framework: Learn Prompting's problem-solving method for GenAI
- [Chain of Thought Prompting](https://learnprompting.org/de/docs/intermediate/chain_of_thought): Intermediate guide to Chain of Thought (CoT) prompting technique
- [Giving Instructions](https://learnprompting.org/ar/docs/basics/instructions): Basic instruction prompting guide covering PII removal and data cleaning

## Advanced Prompting Techniques

- [Advanced Decomposition Techniques for Improved Prompting in LLMs](https://learnprompting.org/docs/advanced/decomposition/introduction): Advanced decomposition techniques: Decomposed Prompting, Program-of-Thoughts
- [Plan-and-Solve Prompting: Improving Reasoning and Reducing Errors](https://learnprompting.org/docs/advanced/decomposition/plan_and_solve): Advanced Plan-and-Solve (PS+) prompting technique for LLM reasoning
- [Prompt Ensembling](https://learnprompting.org/de/docs/reliability/ensembling): Prompt ensembling with DiVeRSe and Self-Consistency for reliability
- [Duty-Distinct Chain-of-Thought (DDCoT)](https://learnprompting.org/docs/advanced/decomposition/duty-distinct-chain-of-thought): Advanced DDCoT technique for multimodal reasoning and hallucination reduction

## AI Security & Red-Teaming

- [Announcing HackAPrompt 2.0: The World's Largest AI Red-Teaming Hackathon](https://learnprompting.org/blog/announce-hackaprompt-2): HackAPrompt 2.0 announcement: AI red-teaming competition with $500K prizes
- [Prompt Injection vs. Jailbreaking: What's the Difference?](https://learnprompting.org/blog/injection_jailbreaking): Explains differences between prompt injection and jailbreaking attacks
- [Top 9 Online AI Red Teaming Courses [Free & Paid]](https://learnprompting.org/blog/ai-red-teaming-courses): Top 9 AI red teaming courses for securing AI systems and prompt hacking

## Tools & Resources

- [Prompt Engineering Tools](https://learnprompting.org/ar/docs/tooling/tools): Reference list of prompt engineering tools: LangChain, Dust.tt, OpenPrompt
- [Quality Boosters](https://learnprompting.org/ar/docs/image_prompting/quality_boosters): Image prompting quality boosters for DALLE and text-to-image generation

## AI Models & Technologies

- [OpenAI New Tools for Building Agents](https://learnprompting.org/blog/openai-new-tools-for-building-agents): OpenAI's new agent-building tools for multi-step task automation
- [A Complete Guide to Grok AI (xAI)](https://learnprompting.org/blog/guide-grok): Complete guide to xAI's Grok AI vs ChatGPT and Claude comparison
- [Anthropic Integrates Web Search Capability into Claude AI Assistant](https://learnprompting.org/blog/claude-can-now-search-web): Anthropic adds web search to Claude AI for real-time information access
- [R1-Omni: Explainable Multimodal Emotion Recognition with Reinforcement Learning](https://learnprompting.org/blog/r1-omni-explainable-omni‐multimodal-emotion-recognition-with-reinforcing-learning): Review of Alibaba's R1-Omni model using RL for emotion recognition
